## Description
This folder contains the DV-only perturbation experiments and related robustness, audit, and supplementary diagnostic outputs. It is the main experimental workspace for the identification strategy that perturbs cross-exchange weights while holding observed prices fixed.

## Time range
2021–2022 paper sample, based on synchronized BTCUSD minute data.

## Key variables
Typical DV-only experimental fields include:
- shock type
- delta_w / weight factor
- pivot change indicators
- max_share and related concentration metrics
- VWAP shift measures
- LWMP pivot-based adjustment measures
- summary statistics by bin or quintile

## Generated by
- run_dv_only_injection_experiments.py
- run_exclude_binance.py
- run_exclude_exchange_dvonly.py
- run_subsample_robustness.py
- run_threshold_robustness.py
- audit_lockin_and_build_dvonly_inference.py
- related plotting scripts in `src/plotting/`

## Used in paper
This folder underlies the paper’s central identification strategy and most of the appendix evidence. The paper frames the DV-only design as a diagnostic counterfactual that isolates the reweighting channel rather than the full joint movement of prices and shares. It supports the main LWMP and VWAP contrast as well as the robustness and audit appendices.

## File status
Large DV-only sample files and audit datasets are not included in the GitHub repository because of file-size constraints. Summary figures, summary tables, and selected metadata are represented elsewhere in the public repository.

## Actual storage location
Currently stored locally.

## Notes
This folder mixes final retained outputs and exploratory materials. In the public repository, only final summary outputs, appendix figures/tables, and small metadata files are retained; exploratory and large sample-level objects remain external or archived.
